Class NewExplanationSet

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.NewExplanationSet
public class NewExplanationSet extends Object
Tracks a set of explanations in a story graph and provides a way to add explanations to this set without creating duplicates in the story graph.

This class is similar to ExplanationSet, but it tracks only explanations that have been added to this set; it does not treat the explanations that already exist in the story graph as part of this set.

Author:
Stephen G. Ware
